_comment_template: This is a TEMPLATE. The token __PROJECT_ROOT__ must be substituted with the real
absolute path to the project root before passing to lsp-poke.py.
The token __EXTENSION_API__ must be substituted with the real path to extension_api.json.
File paths and line/column positions are project-specific: copy this file into
__EXTENSION_API__, then fill in real (line, character) positions for each request.
run.sh does this substitution automatically when given --project/--api/--session.

requests.label: hover/cross_file_method
requests._comment: Hover over a cross-file method call site (in __CALLER_FILE__). Position must be on the method name token of a call like `obj.some_method()` where `some_method` is defined in __CALLEE_FILE__. Expected result: contents.value contains 'func' and '->'.

requests.label: definition/class_name_expr
requests._comment: Go-to-definition on a ClassName used in an expression (e.g. `ClassName.new()` or a type annotation `var x: ClassName`). Position must be on the identifier token. Expected result: non-empty locations array pointing to the class_name declaration file.

requests.label: definition/preload_string
requests._comment: Go-to-definition on the string argument of a preload() call, e.g. preload("res://path/to/File.gd"). Position must be INSIDE the string literal. Expected result: non-empty locations array pointing to the preloaded file.

requests.label: definition/autoload_name
requests._comment: Go-to-definition on an autoload singleton name (e.g. `GameManager.some_method()`). Position must be on the autoload identifier token. Expected result: non-empty locations array pointing to the autoload script.

requests.label: references/cross_file_method
requests._comment: Find all references to a method defined in __CALLEE_FILE__. Position must be on the method name at its DEFINITION site. Expected result: non-empty locations array including at least one reference from __CALLER_FILE__.

requests.label: documentSymbol/nested_members
requests._comment: Request document symbols for __CALLEE_FILE__, which must be a class with nested members (functions, variables, inner classes). Expected result: non-empty array with at least one SymbolInformation/DocumentSymbol that has children or where the class symbol appears.

requests.label: implementation/func_with_overrides
requests._comment: Find implementations of a virtual/overridable func defined in __BASE_CLASS_FILE__. Position must be on the func name at the base class definition. Expected result: non-empty locations array pointing to override definitions in __SUBCLASS_FILE__ (and possibly others).

requests.label: documentLink/res_literal
requests._comment: Request document links for __LINK_FILE__, which must contain at least one res:// string literal (e.g. in a preload or load call, or a string constant). Expected result: non-empty DocumentLink array where each link target resolves to an existing project file.
